4 primary-path samples and a later 0.5 threshold approximate antialiasing boundaries.
Viewport evaluated geometry is used after matching modifier visibility and subdivision render levels.
Original render borders and compositor effects are disabled; their presence is recorded.

empty_mask: Visible IoU/recall can be zero, but absent center/precision remain undefined; no zero-error imputation.
